summary: One native run of loader-diag-xnu-ep-md1 (decision 0033). Analyser result: chain row 1b, stage row S4 (keybag skipped, launchd stopped), not S1. The ADT property /chosen/ephemeral-storage=1 worked on the phone: keybagd printed 'DEVICE HAS EPHEMERAL DATA VOLUME, SKIP INIT' (twice, for keybag and usermanagerd) and Apple's launchd ran 11 more boot tasks, then launchd_cache_loader aborted (SecStaticCodeRef errSecCSStaticCodeNotFound, because /System/Library/xpc/launchd.plist does not exist in the donor-built root) and XNU panicked by design (a critical boot task exited). The job com.nat085.ps never ran. The task's question (two job intervals) is therefore answered 'no, at row S4'; per its acceptance a non-S1 row is recorded as the finding and does not complete the task.

findings: S4: keybagd skipped its init on the S24 (hypothesis of NAT-085 confirmed on the phone): ADT /chosen/ephemeral-storage=1 -> sysctl hw.ephemeral_storage -> os_variant_uses_ephemeral_storage.

launchd ran, after keybag, usermanagerd, dirs_cleaner (dc_reset: /tmp, /var/run: Invalid argument), xpcroleaccountd, init_featureflags, auearlyboot (Early Boot: no accessories), tzinit (zoneinfo link missing, symlink reset attempted), finish-restore, finish-demo-restore, sysstatuscheck, prng_seedctl (kernel prng seed and virtual random not loadable), launchd_cache_loader.

launchd_cache_loader: launchd logged 'Unable to open /System/Library/xpc/launchd.plist [2:No such file or directory]' and 'Skipping setting up shared memory with cache loader'; the loader then aborted with errSecCSStaticCodeNotFound and the kernel panicked ('launchd_cache_loader[28] exited -- exit reason namespace 7 subcode 0x1'). References/apple-xnu bsd/kern/kern_exit.c: proc_handle_critical_exit panics for a boot task spawned with the panic-on-crash behaviour; by-design.

The absence of launchd.plist is a property of the donor recipe's system image (build.sh deletes it), not of the delivery (delivery outcome 'delivered', 2,475,720,704 B at 17.055 MB/s; whole-image digest still open under NAT-078).

Host disassembly of the pinned launchd: boot tasks are skipped in launchd's restore/ramdisk mode, which strstr(kern.bootargs, "rd=md0") switches on; this run had rd=md1. Not yet observed on the phone.

A 5,321-byte gap in the returned log (head 8192 + tail 32768) lies between the libignition configuration lines and the FIPS lines; the stage judgement used lines that are present in the tail; absence in the gap is 'not established'.

cause_review.why_launchd_could_not_open_launchd_plist: The delivered root was built by the donor recipe (artifacts/nat-083/recipe/userland/build.sh, 'launchd must load our choice of jobs, not all 500 that Darwin has'), which deletes System/Library/xpc/launchd.plist (and LaunchDaemons, NanoLaunchDaemons, LaunchAngels) from the system image. So the file's absence is by that recipe, not a delivery fault.
cause_review.why_the_cache_loader_task_ran: launchd's Boot dictionary (the plist embedded in /sbin/launchd, section __TEXT,__config) lists launchd_cache_loader with RequireRun+RequireSuccess; launchd decides per task in a predicate (0x10003b8c8): PerformAlways -> run; userspace-reboot flag -> only PerformAfterUserspaceReboot; flag B (restore/ramdisk) and no PerformInRestore -> skip; else run. Flag B is set when strstr(kern.bootargs, "rd=md0") (import _strstr resolved through the chained fixups) or the strings Restore/Ramdisk/RamDisk match. The cmdline of this run had rd=md1, so B was 0 and every boot task ran.
